ParagonLevelCard.xpExplanation: Each trophy gives XP based on its rarity: bronze 10, silver 25, gold 50, and platinum 200. Completing a game adds 100 XP.
ParagonLevelCard.footerHelp: The circle above shows how far you've progressed within your current level. Open this section to see the breakdown and what's left.

ParagonScoreCard.title: Paragon Score
ParagonScoreCard.subtitle: A unified score across platforms
ParagonScoreCard.platformStats: {puntos} pts · {count, plural, one {# trophy} other {# trophies}}
ParagonScoreCard.explanation: PSN weighs by metal (bronze/silver/gold/platinum) and Xbox by its real Gamerscore — both are official data from each platform. Steam has no per-achievement weight of its own, so here it's estimated by global rarity (rarer means more points): it's an approximation, not verifiable data like the other two.
